contests.office: Judge of the Orphans' Court (vote for up to 3)

measures.title: Charter Amendment: Council meeting minutes
measures.summary: Revises the Wicomico County Charter to let the Council Administrator keep minutes of meetings as written minutes, digital recordings, or a combination of both.
measures.yesMeans: The Council Administrator may keep meeting minutes in writing, by digital recording, or both.
measures.noMeans: The Council Administrator must continue to manually type meeting minutes.

measures.title: Charter Amendment: Council communications with the Executive Branch
measures.summary: Revises the Charter so formal communications from the County Council to the Executive Branch go to the County Executive, while Council members and staff may communicate directly with Executive Branch officers and employees for inquiry or information.
measures.yesMeans: Council members and staff may communicate directly with Executive Branch officers and employees for inquiry or information only.
measures.noMeans: All formal communications from the Council to the Executive Branch must still be addressed to the County Executive.

measures.title: Charter Amendment: Acting department heads
measures.summary: Revises the Charter to require that an Acting Director of Administration, Acting Department Head or Acting Deputy Director be a current county employee when appointed. A newly elected County Executive could appoint a non-employee as Acting Director of Administration for up to six months or until a Director of Administration is appointed, whichever comes first.
measures.yesMeans: Acting appointees must be current county employees, except that a new County Executive may appoint an outside Acting Director of Administration for up to six months.
measures.noMeans: The County Executive may appoint acting officials who are not current county employees, with no time limit on a new Executive's acting Director of Administration.

measures.title: Charter Amendment: Definition of work rules
measures.summary: Adds a definition of "Work Rules" to the Charter: policies, procedures and standards governing employee conduct, performance, attendance, workplace behavior, use of county property and other conditions of employment, which may lead to disciplinary action if not followed.
measures.yesMeans: A definition of "Work Rules" is added to the County Charter.
measures.noMeans: No definition of "Work Rules" is added to the Charter.
